aluminum_nvt_subtask_melting.name: Aluminum NVT Equilibration for melting
aluminum_nvt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, equilibrate the system under NVT conditions with the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in x, y and z direction. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the final density in g/cm^3.
aluminum_nvt_subtask_melting.submission_format: {"density" : numerical value without units, "path to relaxed structure" : path} eg, {"density" : 56.00, "path to relaxed structure" : /structures/structure.dat}
